subject: general
question: Which among the following Indian states received the International Tourism Award 2023 for Best Destination for Culture by the Pacific Area Travel Writers Association (PATWA)?
solution:
The correct answer is __West Bengal.__​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• West Bengal has been accredited with the International Travel Award 2023, for 'best destination for culture' by the Pacific Area Travel Writers Association (PATWA), an affiliate of the UN World Tourism Organisation.
 
• The award will be conferred in Berlin, at the World Tourism & Aviation Leaders' Summit on March 9, 2023.
 
• PATWA is an organisation of travel writers that was founded in 1998.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• West Bengal is a state in eastern India.
 
• It is the fourth-most populous state and the thirteenth-largest state by area in India.
 
• It also borders the Indian states of Odisha, Jharkhand, Bihar, Sikkim and Assam.
 
• West Bengal includes the Darjeeling Himalayan hill region, the Ganges delta, the coastal Sundarbans and the Bay of Bengal.
 
• West Bengal:
 
 
• Capital: Kolkata
 
• Chief Minister: Mamata Banerjee
 
• Established: 26 January 1950
 
• Districts: 23
 
• Sex ratio (2011): 947 /1000 
 
• Literacy (2011): 77.08%
